## Problem and result

Explain what changes for the caller or worker and why.

## Validation

List relevant commands/results and any behavior that remains unverified.
For UI changes, include sanitized screenshots or a short recording.

## Scope and compatibility

Note configuration/deployment effects, migration needs, or upstream material
copied/adapted. Preserve applicable notices and update provenance when needed.

- [ ] No credentials or private task output are included.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the implemented behavior and its limitations.
